data_and_models: No trained model of their own named: off-the-shelf MediaPipe pose estimation and a scikit-learn anomaly detector over per-user session data. No dataset, sample size, threshold or metric appears on the page.
name: NeuroGuard AI

numbers.arithmetic: unfalsifiable as published - no sensitivity, false-alarm rate or session count is given
numbers.claim: detects unusual changes versus a personal baseline
numbers.denominator: each user's own prior sessions; count and window not stated

one_line: Concussion recovery tracking that scores short cognitive and camera-based physical tests against the patient's own baseline and flags unusual change.

sections.accomplishments: One accessible platform combining cognitive testing, camera-based physical monitoring and baseline-relative trend alerts; positioned as recovery support, not a diagnostic replacement.
sections.challenges: Assessments simple enough for anyone to use while still producing meaningful signal; individual differences; keeping the framing away from unsafe medical claims.
sections.how_we_built_it: A Streamlit app: MediaPipe pose for the physical tests, numpy/pandas for the session series, a scikit-learn anomaly detector over the personal baseline, plus session-to-session data tracking.
sections.inspiration: Recovery is not linear and occasional clinic assessments miss most of it; they wanted continuous, self-administered tracking rather than a snapshot.
sections.learned: Personal baselines beat population thresholds for monitoring; safety, explainability and accessibility matter as much as model accuracy.
sections.what_it_does: Short cognitive tests (reaction time, memory, attention) plus camera-based balance/movement assessment, a recovery dashboard, and alerts when performance moves away from the user's own baseline.
sections.what_next: Larger and more diverse datasets, stronger camera pose analysis, clinically informed assessments, wearable integration.

testing: No test suite, evaluation set, or validation against clinical measures is described; the page presents the concept and a prototype update, not results.
